item: Two fault-harness scenarios for a launcher with no boot id (pid reuse)
summary: bootless-sigkill and bootless-reused-pid run only when named (the default four are unchanged): the copy of launch.sh finds no boot id, as on Windows and macOS. The first checks the launcher's own record is joined by pid; the second plants an old row with the server's pid, kills server and launcher together, and checks the old row is not shown as this session's end. Measured red with the date guard in exit_evidence._ended_before reverted (both the exit row and the stderr row shown), green with it. Run once on Linux, about 38 s each; a real Windows or macOS launcher is still untested.
